verdict.rationale: Gusto documents API retrieval of payrolls (GET /v1/companies/{company_uuid}/payrolls), lists "Generate payroll reports" as a platform capability, mentions accounting apps among its integration partners, and offers an official MCP server that lets an LLM access Gusto account data. So an agent can pull payroll data, but nothing in the evidence describes a journal-entry or general-ledger export, and reconciliation into a ledger is not documented. Missing for 10: journal/GL-specific report or export endpoint, documented ledger reconciliation or accounting sync workflow, agent hands-on corroboration of pulling and reconciling payroll journals.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can have an agent pull payroll journal data via API or export and reconcile the entries into my ledger

citations.quote: Upcoming regular payrolls can be retrieved by calling GET /v1/companies/{company_uuid}/payrolls
The Gusto MCP server allows you to access your data housed within Gusto using natural language within a variety of AI platforms, such as Claude, ChatGPT, and Gemini.
We work with many types of apps, including accounting, applicant tracking, performance management, time tracking, and business operations software.
